facts.text: The Wedgewood Hotel & Spa is located in the heart of Downtown Vancouver.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of Downtown Vancouver, the Wedgewood Hotel & Spa is a family-owned and operated boutique hotel

facts.text: The Wedgewood is a family-owned and operated boutique hotel.
facts.excerpt: the Wedgewood Hotel & Spa is a family-owned and operated boutique hotel

facts.text: The hotel's address is across from Robson Square and the Vancouver Art Gallery.
facts.excerpt: With its distinguished address across from picturesque Robson Square and Vancouver Art Gallery

facts.text: The Spa at the Wedgewood has a relaxation lounge, a eucalyptus steam room, private treatment rooms and couples massage suites.
facts.excerpt: Featuring a tranquil relaxation lounge, a eucalyptus steam room, well appointed private treatment rooms, and spacious couples massage suites to accommodate a variety of treatments.

facts.text: Founder Eleni Skalbania bought the former Mayfair Apartment Hotel in 1984 and fully renovated and redesigned it, acting as her own designer.
facts.excerpt: She found the perfect location in 1984 when she purchased the former Mayfair Apartment Hotel

facts.text: To create the ambience of a European country house, the founder displayed art and antiques she had collected and commissioned custom-built furniture.
facts.excerpt: To create the ambience of a European country-house she displayed a collection of art and antiques she had personally collected, and commissioned craftsmen to build custom-designed furniture.

facts.text: The Wedgewood opened in 1984 as the first female-owned boutique property in Canada, and the 4th Baron of Wedgwood attended the opening.
facts.excerpt: To signify the opening of the first female-owned boutique property in Canada, the 4th Baron of Wedgwood attended the opening

facts.text: The Wedgewood is a second-generation, female owned-and-operated property.
facts.excerpt: As a second generation female owned-and-operated property

facts.text: Bacchus Restaurant & Lounge, inside the hotel, has Venetian decor and original artwork.
facts.excerpt: Tucked away inside the Wedgewood, Michelin-Recommended Bacchus Restaurant & Lounge beckons with beautiful Venetian decor, original artwork and impeccable service.

facts.text: Bacchus Restaurant is Michelin-Recommended.
facts.excerpt: Michelin-Recommended Bacchus Restaurant & Lounge

facts.text: Bacchus Lounge offers classic cocktails and live piano performances nightly.
facts.excerpt: A sophisticated destination for casual favourites, classic cocktails and live piano performances nightly

facts.text: Afternoon tea is available daily and uses teas from Vancouver purveyor Murchie's.
facts.excerpt: It’s available daily and puts a local spin on things by using a Vancouver purveyor, Murchie’s, to stock all their teas.

facts.text: Larger rooms can come with terraces, fireplaces and standalone bathtubs.
facts.excerpt: Larger rooms can come with terraces, fireplaces and standalone bath tubs.

facts.text: Even the smallest rooms have separate sitting areas and work desks.
facts.excerpt: Even the smallest rooms have separate sitting areas and work desks.

facts.text: The Veranda Suite has a private veranda terrace with a city and partial mountain view.
facts.excerpt: 420 sq. ft. private veranda terrace

facts.text: The Terrace Penthouse Suites have an additional patio area and a Robson Square Garden view.
facts.excerpt: **Terrace Penthouse Suite – 1201**

facts.text: The hotel can arrange bike rentals and private yoga classes on request.
facts.excerpt: The hotel can also arrange bike rentals and private yoga classes upon request.

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler suggests renting a bike and heading for the Seawall to Stanley Park.
facts.excerpt: grabbing a bike rental and heading for the Seawall to Stanley Park

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes the gym as small but serviceable, with TechnoGym equipment.
facts.excerpt: There’s a small, but serviceable gym with TechnoGym equipment.

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler rates the hotel as not particularly family friendly.
facts.excerpt: Not particularly; one child under 12 is included in the room rate

facts.text: Executive Rooms have a limited laneway view.
facts.excerpt: - Limited Laneway View

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler calls the hotel best for a romantic getaway and travelers looking for old-school luxury.
facts.excerpt: A romantic getaway, travelers looking for a little old-school luxury

facts.text: The Wedgewood is a Relais & Chateaux member.
facts.excerpt: a distinguished Relais & Chateaux member

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler says Bacchus can be a tougher table than most hotel restaurants, so reserve in advance.
facts.excerpt: Since it’s highly rated, it can be a tougher table than most hotel restaurants. Make sure to reserve in advance.
